_comment: Licenses verified by hand. A package is listed when its metadata carries no license, or when the guard flags GPL wording that a human checked and cleared. Keys starting with _ are notes. Verify against the project's repo before adding one.
_matplotlib: Bundles FreeType, dual-licensed 'FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later'; used under the FreeType License (its credit notice is in Acknowledgements.txt).
_pandas: The guard matches the 'GPL-compatible?' column of the PSF license-history table in its License field; pandas itself is BSD-3-Clause.
_scipy: Bundles libgfortran, libquadmath and libgcc_s under GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1. The GCC Runtime Library Exception permits shipping them with non-GPL software (as every scipy wheel does); their license text is in Acknowledgements.txt. Only mlx-audio (via mlx-vlm) needs scipy.
